meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动变成讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要向团队讲解代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into an explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to others

howto.what: 把 GitHub 代码改动(PR)变成讲解视频:读取 PR 的 diff、提交和文件,按 code-editorial 风格逐帧生成动画,输出带配音、字幕的 mp4。只处理代码变更,不处理普通网页或产品宣传。
howto.when: 当你给出 GitHub 拉取请求(PR 链接、owner/repo#N、或已检出仓库中的“this PR”)并要求做成代码变更解说视频时触发。如果是产品宣传、非 PR 主题解说,或意图不明确,会改走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把 owner/repo#123 做成一个 3 分钟的代码讲解视频。
把当前仓库里这个 PR 做成重构讲解视频,用男声配音。

howto.what_en: Turns a given GitHub PR into an explainer video: reads its diff, commits and files, then builds it frame by frame in code-editorial style, outputting an mp4 with narration, captions and credits. Only for code changes, not websites or promos.
howto.when_en: Triggers when given a GitHub PR (URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR') and asked to make a code-change explainer video. Not for promos or non-PR topics; unclear intent routes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn owner/repo#123 into a 3-minute code explainer video.
say_en.note: It reads the PR's diff, commits and files, then renders an mp4 with narration.

say_en.text: Make a changelog-style feature-reveal video for owner/repo#42.
say_en.note: Follows the code-editorial style; storyboard first for approval.

say_en.text: Turn this PR in the current repo into a refactor walkthrough, with a male voice.
say_en.note: If no voice is specified, the default narration voice is Marcia (female).
